reference_role: composition, camera, era, palette, and architectural reference; not an edit target
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: disposable art-direction sample for the user's HD graphics layer for Sid Meier's Colonization (1994). Input image 1 is ONLY a composition, camera, era, palette, and architectural reference, not an edit target. Generate a new landscape sample of the upper-left settlement artwork, excluding ALL UI, HUD, text, buttons, numbers, icons, flags, borders, logos and watermarks. Keep the same shallow top-down orthographic game view, same building footprints and arrangement as the referenced settlement: a white two-storey gabled town hall with three roof chimneys in the upper central area, smaller timber-and-plaster houses, a timber church and simple open timber workshop, sparse green deciduous trees, pale sandy grass ground, a split-rail fence at lower right, a small blue-coated settler with red cap near the town hall. Draw terrain, buildings and the small character together so the user can judge style compatibility. Preserve recognizability and readable silhouettes at actual gameplay scale. No new gameplay objects, no new roads, no modern architecture, no cinematic camera tilt, no photorealism. The result is a visual concept only, not an exact layout or final sprite atlas. Render at 1536x1024 or similar landscape proportion. Variant A: refined high-resolution pixel art, very deliberate crisp small square pixels, richer material detail than 1994 while preserving the original earthy cream, olive, brown and slate-blue palette. Retain pixel-art shading, clean edges, readable dark outlines, no blur, no smooth gradients. A coherent HD pixel-art redraw, not merely a nearest-neighbor enlargement.
